rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for genuine personal sincerity or heartfelt feeling.

example.english: You can feel my sincerity when I thank you for all your support.
example.traditional: 我真心多謝你一路咁支持我。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zan1 sam1 do1 ze6 nei5 jat1 lou6 gam3 zi1 ci4 ngo5

rows.note: Use this when sincerity is shown through an effort, gesture, offer, or intention, especially in 有冇誠意.

example.english: I can feel your sincerity in the gift you made especially for me.
example.traditional: 你特登整咗呢份禮物，我感受到你嘅誠意。
example.jyutping: nei5 dak6 dang1 zing2 zo2 ni1 fan6 lai5 mat6 ngo5 gam2 sau6 dou3 nei5 ge3 sing4 ji3

rows.note: Use this more formal term for sincerity as an abstract quality, especially in careful or written language.

example.english: We believe sincerity is the foundation of trust.
example.traditional: 我哋相信，真誠係建立信任嘅基礎。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 soeng1 seon3 zan1 sing4 hai6 gin3 laap6 seon3 jam6 ge3 gei1 co2
